additionalDefects.cause: Collector missing-publish-gate recovery could treat an existing ready, processed, or upload route path of the wrong filesystem type as absence rather than an invalid route state.
additionalDefects.prevention: Test untyped existence for the exact ready, processed, and upload paths; require every existing route object to be a leaf before deciding ready-versus-processed state; require upload absence; then require exactly one ready or processed leaf bound byte-for-byte to the durable apply intent.
